heading: Pandemic Politics in Germany
excerpt: An infographic showing how the COVID-19 outbreak changed support for Germany’s governing and opposition parties.
content: Since the COVID-19 outbreak, Germany’s political scene has transformed significantly. While the CDU has jumped in the polls, support for the SPD has only increased slightly. Opposition parties have faced setbacks, mainly the formerly trending Greens, laissez-faire FDP, and far-right AfD.
